scenarios.name: Bear
scenarios.assumptions: AI SoC tester orders digest after a strong FY3/27; CPU/ASIC demand grows more slowly; memory tester ramp slips; DRAM and component costs are not fully passed through; utilisation falls and FY3/28 operating margin drops to 48%.

scenarios.name: Base
scenarios.assumptions: SoC capacity above 5,000 units expands toward the 10,000-unit target; CPU becomes a third AI driver alongside GPU and custom ASIC; memory testers step up in Q4 FY3/27 and grow in FY3/28; H2 FY3/27 operating margin 51.0%; FY3/28 revenue grows about 30% and net income about 25%.

scenarios.name: Bull
scenarios.assumptions: 10,000-unit SoC capacity target is pulled forward materially; CPU attach rate and test intensity rise; custom ASIC and GPU demand remain hot; silicon photonics starts contributing in FY3/28; richer mix lifts FY3/28 operating margin to 55%.

valuation.ev_ebitda_multiple_rationale: Applied to FY3/28E EBITDA; set between the 15-20x historical range for high-growth ATE peers and the 25x P/E anchor in the 4 Nov investment report, reflecting Advantest's net-cash balance sheet and AI-driven growth.
valuation.method_note: P/E is the primary method on FY3/28E diluted EPS; EV/EBITDA is a cross-check on FY3/28E EBITDA (operating profit plus depreciation).

warnings: The 28 Oct 2026 release labels the year ending 31 Mar 2027 as FY2026; this model uses the canonical FY3/27 label.

FY3/27 forecast is above company guidance: revenue ¥1,900.0bn vs ¥1,863.0bn and operating profit ¥994.7bn vs ¥967.0bn because we adopt the 4 Nov investment report's H2 revenue of ¥1,054.8bn and 51.0% H2 operating margin, above the company-implied H2 figures.
Ordinary profit is mapped to IFRS income before income taxes; FY3/26 actual ordinary profit is not disclosed in the excerpts and is left null.
Q3/Q4 FY3/27 split is an assumption based on management saying Q4 sales exceed Q3 and memory tester sales step up in Q4; the exact fractions are shown in quarterly_plan.
FY3/28 and FY3/29 are independent forecasts; FY3/29 has no company guidance and is bridged from capacity, CPU, memory and silicon-photonics drivers.
Silicon photonics 'starting next fiscal year' from the Nov 2026 calls maps to FY3/28; we assume an initial contribution of about ¥30bn, not full run-rate.
No segment-level operating profit is disclosed in the excerpts, so the segments block is left empty to avoid inventing a split.
Gross debt is assumed zero because no borrowings line is disclosed; lease liabilities of ¥20.2bn are included in net debt.
Depreciation, working-capital change and capex are analyst assumptions; payout ratio is set at 50% following the company's total payout policy of 50% or more over the three-year plan.
No consensus table appears in the documents, so consensus is null.
Diluted shares are estimated from the H1 basic/diluted EPS bridge; no convertible instruments are disclosed.
Company guidance EPS of ¥1,027.08 is on a basic-share basis; model forecast EPS uses the diluted average share count.
Quarterly plan has no H1 guidance row: H1 rebuilt from reported Q1 FY3/27 + Q2 FY3/27, so the Q2 line is definitional; H2 = FY3/27 guidance - H1 still checks the reported Q3/Q4.
FY3/27 quarters follow management guidance (1863 revenue) while the annual row is the model's own forecast (1900): they are meant to differ.
FY3/27 quarters follow management guidance (967 operating_profit) while the annual row is the model's own forecast (994.7): they are meant to differ.
